//: Tailwind CSS v4 uses at-rules (@theme, @utility, @apply, ...) that VS Code's built-in CSS language service doesn't recognise. This keeps mbapp/app/globals.css warning-free WITHOUT remapping the file's language. Approach: (1) teach the validator the at-rules via css.customData, and (2) ignore any it still doesn't know. The Tailwind compiler handles these correctly — the production build already passes. NOTE: this file lives at the WORKSPACE ROOT because VS Code only reads .vscode/settings.json from the root, not from nested folders like mbapp/.
